quests.instruction: What makes a T-shirt different from many other shirts?
quests.correctAnswer: It is a pullover top, often with short sleeves 👕
options: It is a pullover top, often with short sleeves 👕
It always has a collar and buttons 👔
It always closes with a zipper 🤐
quests.explanation: A T-shirt is a simple pullover top, often with short sleeves. Many other shirts have collars and buttons.
quests.funFact: The T-shirt was named for its T shape.

quests.instruction: Lina wants a shirt she can button up the front. Which should she choose?
quests.hint: The clue is in the closing.
quests.explanation: A button-up shirt opens down the front with buttons, so it is put on like a jacket.
quests.funFact: Button-up shirts often have a collar.

quests.instruction: Kai needs a shirt that is quick to pull on for sports class. Which is easier?
quests.explanation: A T-shirt has no buttons to fasten, so it goes on fast.
quests.funFact: Many sports teams use T-shirts as practice jerseys.

quests.instruction: How do coats usually differ from jackets?
quests.explanation: Coats are made for colder weather, so they are usually thicker and longer than jackets.
quests.funFact: Parkas are a kind of warm winter coat.

quests.instruction: On a cool autumn day, Sana wants a layer that isn't too heavy. Which is better?
quests.hint: Focus on how much warmth you need today.
quests.explanation: A light jacket is enough for cool days. A winter coat would be too warm.
quests.funFact: Layers let you adjust to the weather.

quests.instruction: Which would you most likely pull on over a hoodie in deep snow?
quests.hint: It must be thick and warm.
quests.explanation: A winter coat over a hoodie gives layers of warmth for deep snow.
quests.funFact: Snow can be below freezing for days.

quests.instruction: What is the main difference between shoes and boots?
quests.correctAnswer: Boots cover more of the ankle and leg 🥾
options: Shoes cover more of the leg than boots 👟
Boots are only worn in summer ☀️
Boots cover more of the ankle and leg 🥾
quests.explanation: Boots reach up around the ankle or higher. Most shoes stop at the ankle.
quests.funFact: Some boots come up to the knee.

quests.instruction: Tomás has a long walk through wet grass. Which would protect his feet and ankles better?
quests.explanation: Boots cover the ankle and keep wet grass off your feet.
quests.funFact: Many boots are made with waterproof materials.

quests.instruction: Which of these is a shoe that is NOT meant for walking outdoors?
quests.hint: The name hints at where it's used.
quests.explanation: Slippers have thin soles and are for indoors only. Outdoor shoes have thicker soles.
quests.funFact: Slippers keep floors cleaner because they stay indoors.

quests.instruction: Which is better for a hot day at the playground?
quests.explanation: Shorts leave the legs uncovered, so heat escapes and you stay cool.
quests.funFact: Shorts were first worn as part of school uniforms.

quests.instruction: Why might Priya choose long pants over shorts for a hike in bushy areas?
options: To stay cooler in the sun 🌞
quests.explanation: Long pants shield legs from scratches, sunburn, and insect bites.
quests.funFact: Hikers sometimes wear pants that zip into shorts.

quests.instruction: It's a cold, windy day. Which lower garment is the best?
quests.hint: Which one covers the legs and holds in warmth?
quests.explanation: Thick pants cover the legs and hold in heat. Shorts leave legs open to the wind.
quests.funFact: Lined pants have a soft layer inside for extra warmth.

quests.instruction: What is the main job of socks that shoes can't do?
quests.correctAnswer: Soak up sweat and cushion the foot 🧦
options: Soak up sweat and cushion the foot 🧦
Protect the foot from sharp stones 🪨
quests.explanation: Socks cushion the foot and soak up moisture. Shoes provide the hard outer protection.
quests.funFact: Different socks are made for different activities.

quests.instruction: Diego forgot his socks but needs to wear his closed shoes. What could happen?
quests.correctAnswer: His feet might get sore from rubbing 🦶
options: His feet might get sore from rubbing 🦶
quests.explanation: Without socks, shoes rub directly on your skin, which can cause blisters.
quests.funFact: Blisters form when skin rubs against something repeatedly.

quests.instruction: Why do we usually take off shoes but not socks at the doorway?
options: Socks don't carry any dirt at all ✨
Shoes are too heavy to wear indoors 🏋️
quests.explanation: Shoes pick up dirt, mud, and germs outdoors, so people take them off at the door to keep floors clean.
quests.funFact: In many homes around the world, people remove shoes at the door.

quests.instruction: What makes pajamas different from daytime clothes?
quests.correctAnswer: They are soft and loose for sleeping 😴
options: They are soft and loose for sleeping 😴
quests.explanation: Pajamas are made to be comfortable in bed, so they are soft and not tight.
quests.funFact: Pajamas are usually made of soft cotton or flannel.

quests.instruction: Why should school clothes be changed before bed?
quests.correctAnswer: They were worn all day and may be dirty 🧼
options: They were worn all day and may be dirty 🧼
They would shrink if slept in 📉
They are too bright for the bedroom 🌈
quests.explanation: School clothes picked up dirt and sweat all day. Changing keeps your sheets cleaner and helps you rest.
quests.funFact: Bedding stays cleaner when you don't wear outside clothes in bed.

quests.instruction: Mei is cold at night, but her pajamas are thin. What could she add?
quests.correctAnswer: A warm blanket or cozy socks 🧦
options: A pair of shorts and a tank top 🩳
A warm blanket or cozy socks 🧦
A thin summer sheet and bare feet 🛏️
quests.hint: Add warmth without a big change.
quests.explanation: Cozy socks or a blanket add warmth without making her too hot.
quests.funFact: Warm sleep clothing should be light enough to avoid overheating.

quests.instruction: How is a raincoat different from an ordinary cotton jacket?
quests.correctAnswer: It does not soak up water 🌧️
options: It does not soak up water 🌧️
It is made without any seams 🧵
quests.hint: Focus on what happens in rain.
quests.explanation: A raincoat blocks water. A cotton jacket gets soaked.
quests.funFact: Rubber and some plastics are waterproof.

quests.instruction: Which pair of shoes is a better choice for a rainy day?
quests.explanation: Rubber doesn't absorb water. Suede and cloth soak it up.
quests.funFact: Suede is leather with a soft, fuzzy surface.

quests.instruction: Water spills on a rain jacket and a cotton shirt. What do you see?
quests.correctAnswer: Drops bead up on the rain jacket 💧
options: Drops vanish from both at once ✨
Drops bead up on the rain jacket 💧
Drops bead up on the cotton shirt 👕
quests.explanation: Waterproof fabric makes drops roll off, while cotton absorbs them.
quests.funFact: Water forms round beads on waterproof surfaces.

quests.instruction: Which fabric traps the most warmth?
quests.explanation: Fleece has a fuzzy surface that traps air, so it is warm.
quests.funFact: Fleece is lightweight even though it's warm.

quests.instruction: Which clothes help the body cool down in the heat?
quests.explanation: Loose, light clothes let air flow around the skin, helping sweat evaporate and cool you.
quests.funFact: Sweat cools you down when it dries.

quests.instruction: Ravi is chilly. Which choice would warm him up the fastest?
quests.explanation: A sweater traps heat close to the body. Taking off clothes or opening a window does the opposite.
quests.funFact: Putting on a hat helps quickly because heat escapes from the head.

quests.instruction: Sam says, 'A hoodie and a sweater are exactly the same.' What is a difference?
quests.explanation: A hoodie has a hood and a sweater usually doesn't.
quests.funFact: Hoodies are often made from soft cotton blends.

quests.instruction: Which is a kind of sleepwear?
quests.explanation: Pajamas are sleepwear. Raincoats and sunhats are for outside.
quests.funFact: Nightgowns and onesies are other kinds of sleepwear.

quests.instruction: Which of these is NOT a shoe but is worn on the foot?
quests.explanation: Socks are worn on feet but aren't shoes; they go under shoes.
quests.funFact: Socks can also be worn without shoes on soft floors.

quests.instruction: Aisha lays out boots, sandals, and sneakers. What group do they belong to?
quests.hint: They all go on the same place.
quests.explanation: All three are worn on the feet, so they are footwear.
quests.funFact: Footwear includes anything you wear on your feet.

quests.instruction: Coats, jackets, and raincoats are worn over other clothes. What are they called?
quests.explanation: Outerwear is clothing worn on top of other clothes, usually to protect from weather.
quests.funFact: Outerwear keeps the layers underneath dry and warm.

quests.instruction: Which pair is matched correctly with the body part it covers?
quests.hint: Check each pair against the body.
quests.explanation: Shorts cover the legs. Scarves go around the neck and hats go on the head.
quests.funFact: Clothes are often named for the body part they cover.
